001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.plog;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006
007public class PLStatSupplies extends BasePLStat {
008
009        @Override
010        public long getCurrentValue() {

013
014        @Override
015        public Color getGraphColor() {
016                return Global.getSettings().getColor("graphSuppliesColor");

018
019        @Override

036        
037}
